items.author: giuseppeg
items.body:
# RFC: Version Pinning for add-skill

Add support for installing specific versions of skills via git tags, commits, or branches.

## Problem

- No way to pin a skill to a specific version
- Setups are non-reproducible across machines/team members
- If a skill author pushes a breaking change, your setup breaks silently
- No way to audit what version is installed or roll back

## Proposal

### Syntax

```bash
npx add-skill owner/repo@v1.0.0      # tag
npx add-skill owner/repo@abc1234     # commit sha
npx add-skill owner/repo@main        # explicit branch
npx add-skill owner/repo             # la
items.title: [RFC] Versioning
